# USTECH Innovations

> Manufacturer of inline and at-line near-infrared (NIR and FT-NIR) analyzers,
> chemometrics software (caliX) and process-control software (ProChem) for food,
> feed, dairy, chemical and pharmaceutical processing. Founded 2023,
> headquartered in Durham, North Carolina, USA.

## Products
- [ProLine17EC](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-proline-17ec.html): Inline NIR analyzer, 950-1650 nm InGaAs array, IP65 316 stainless steel housing, sapphire window
- [ProLine17ECS](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-proline-17ecs.html): Inline NIR analyzer with high-speed InGaAs detection and dual-chassis IP65 housing
- [ProLine2550](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-proline-2550.html): Inline FT-NIR process analyzer for blenders, reactors and pipelines
- [MasterLine](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-masterline.html): Benchtop FT-NIR analyzer for grains, feed ingredients and forage
- [caliX](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-calix.html): Chemometrics and calibration software (PLS, PCA, AutoML) for NIR, FTIR and Raman data
- [ProChem](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-prochem.html): Analyzer software linking USTECH analyzers to PLC/SCADA: live dashboards, alarms, setpoint control
- [StarchQC](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-starchqc.html): Damaged-starch analyzer for flour (amperometric method)
- [Tornado+](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/product-tornado.html): Water-cooled laboratory sample mill for grains, seeds and feed

## Industries
- [Food & Feed](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/industry-food-feed.html): Inline NIR for feed mills and food processing
- [Dairy](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/industry-dairy.html): Fat standardization and yield optimization
- [Chemical & Pharma](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/industry-chemical-pharma.html): NIR for process analytical technology (PAT) in chemical and pharmaceutical production

## Knowledge
- [Technology](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/knowledge-technology.html): How NIR spectroscopy and calibration science work
- [FAQ](https://www.ustechinnovations.com/faq.html): Technical questions and answers
